correctness.rationale: Collinearity in the \(|3O|\) embedding gives the exact zero-sum law. Doubling sends every sextactic secant to either a singleton or an affine line in \(F[3]\); fibre counts follow exactly from \(F[2]\). The full \(54\)-element affine complex-multiplication action on \(F[6]\) was exhaustively enumerated from the packaged verifier, which returned orbit sizes \(9,18,54\) and stabilizers \(6,3,1\). No infinite conclusion is inferred from partial sampling.

value.rationale: The \(81\)-line configuration is a central finite geometry attached to the Fermat cubic. The result provides a canonical torsion-theoretic classifier and determines all projective symmetry orbits and stabilizers, distinguishing collapsed, complex-multiplication-special, and generic secants. This is a natural structural invariant, not an arbitrary finite slice or a routine recomputation.
